text:
My honest review based on my experience:
Throughout my orthodontic treatment since July 20, 2024:

According to the promotion, I had to come every month
to receive a free clear retainer.

However, I didn't receive this benefit because I missed appointments in January and July (due to surgery).
I couldn't open my mouth wide because of the pain from the surgery.
I informed the clinic in advance about this.
The clinic didn't mention that I wouldn't receive the benefit if I didn't come every month. I wasn't upset about this point, but...

What really upset me was that I spoke with my orthodontist
to explain my missed appointments.
The doctor said I missed appointments in June and August.
These two months were due to the administrator, possibly a miscommunication.
But when I spoke to the doctor in person, the administrator remained silent and didn't say anything.

- In June 2024, my appointment was at 10:00 AM, but it was rescheduled
to 8:00 PM.
Just as I was about to arrive at the clinic, the administrator called to inform me that the doctor was going home. (The doctor didn't wait for the appointment) and the admin rescheduled our appointment for the next month.
*At that time, we planned to arrive at the clinic at 7:30 PM.
Because we had errands to run outside.
The admin called and told us to hurry to the clinic at 7:00 PM.
Which was too late. But if we arrived at 7:30 PM, we would have made it.
However, the doctor would be going home, so they wouldn't wait for the appointment.

-In August, the admin gave the wrong doctor's schedule.

(The doctor who treated us was Dr. Toy, but the admin gave Dr. Canon's schedule.)
Then the admin rescheduled us to September.

There was miscommunication, short and abrupt responses, and they criticized us in the chat for not being discriminatory.

And we had kept a record of all the payments made and how many times.
But the admin incorrectly stated that we still owed 15,000 baht.
Even though we only owed 13,200 baht.
They didn't check the information beforehand, so we had to go to the clinic to check ourselves.

P.S. Dr. Toy does excellent orthodontics, and the clinic is very good.

We have now requested to transfer our case.

This review is based on real experience.
Thank you.
